opportunities.Title: Field Service Engineer
opportunities.BriefDescription:
Field Service Engineer

Are you someone who thrives on helping others? Enjoys solving challenging technical problems? Is passionate about working hands-on with computer or data center hardware? Then you may be interested in the Field Service Engineer (FSE) position that we have available. 

It's an opportunity to join a team that meets the 24/7 data center maintenance needs of local customers with a focus on delivering exceptional service with each interaction. You will provide onsite system diagnostic and analytical support to customers within a geographical territory, or assigned to a specific account, supporting the customer per the terms of the Service Level Agreement (SLA) with Park Place Technologies.

opportunities.Title: Sales Development Associate - June 2027
opportunities.BriefDescription:
Sales Development Associate
As a Sales Development Associate (SDA), you should be enthusiastic about learning the fundamentals of sales and generating qualified leads for our sales teams. This role is a precursor to being promoted to a Business Development Representative where you will receive continuing sales education, learn how to prospect for the different selling departments at Park Place Technologies, and gain more insight into all of the products and services we offer our prospective and existing customers. The Business Development Representative role is the step before an account manager role. Time in the Sales Development Associate role is generally 3 to 4 months.
